checks: Native FerroUI canvas contains rendered UI and document pixels
R shortcut and pointer drag create and render a selected rectangle
Keyboard undo removes the pointer-created node
Keyboard redo restores the node
Delete keyboard action removes the selection
Document JSON round-trip restores the complete edited document
SVG file import selects an editable frame with affine groups, gradients, curves, and Unicode text
PNG download has exact artboard dimensions and verified background, affine gradient, curved stroke, and text pixels
JSON round-trip preserves the complete imported SVG hierarchy and visual properties
Enter enters native vector editing; an anchor drag rebases bounds without moving other anchors and forms one undo/redo step
Native Pen pointer drags create a cubic curve and the complete path is one undo/redo step
Enter while the Pen pointer is held finalizes the gesture and ignores later handle movement until release
Native on-canvas TextBox handles multiline Unicode, UTF-8 rich-text ranges, Ctrl+Enter commit, Escape cancel, one-step history, and autosave
Browser composition events commit once, keep preedit out of the document, and cannot block or overwrite a new native text client after cancellation
Pagehide during unfinished composition durably saves confirmed Unicode and formatting, preserves one-step history, and survives a real reload
Native paint dialog pointer/keyboard input converts a fill to a gradient, edits alpha/opacity/stop positions, rejects NaN, and supports one-step stop undo
Native fractional polygon radius preserves the editable triangle, box and transform, rejects negative/nonfinite drafts without changing history, and restores the complete document with one undo/redo
Native paint-card entry and immutable hover expose distinct tied-stop markers for one affine reflected gradient fill while preserving the shared style, radius binding, sibling and complete document
A fractional endpoint drag uses the inverse full layer transform, changes only the chosen paint, detaches its shared fill style, preserves unrelated bindings and commits one exactly reversible edit
Escape, late pointer events, an exact drag-back and an unchanged tied-stop press restore every style/binding field and preserve a real redo entry without appending history
Real Chromium touch cancellation reaches the native gradient capture-loss path, restores the full shared-style snapshot and selection, and leaves the prior endpoint edit exactly redoable
Stop drags project onto the transformed world axis, clamp to 0–1, and retain authored stop indices and RGBA colors through crossings and ties with exact single-step undo/redo
Dragging a bare native gradient axis translates both relative endpoints together without changing stops, paint order, opacity, shape geometry, transforms or the linked sibling
From a clean IndexedDB baseline, a held gradient draft is committed by real pagehide alone into exactly one history entry, serialization and durable revision; late release cannot duplicate the commit
Actual Ctrl+S finishes a held native gradient drag once before the portable download is serialized; the file contains every preview field and the late release preserves exact undo/redo

A real axis double-click appends an interpolated stop, Alt+ArrowRight nudges its offset by 0.001, Tab visits authored source indices without editing, and Delete removes exactly that stop with exact history without deleting the layer

Deleting below two stops produces a fresh native error while preserving exact redo; Enter exits the editor and native PNG pixels verify the edited gradient without adorners or unsupported rendering effects

Native radial paint-card entry exposes the actual ellipse and center/radius controls; reflected and sheared pointer motion edits the shared relative radius and center with exact undo/redo and unchanged stops
Radial handle drag-back restores the exact document during capture, leaves redo executable, and paints a real native ellipse adorner without adding history
Angular gradient handles preserve native local-pixel angles on a nonsquare affine box; a real sweep-handle drag crosses 360 degrees continuously while distinct seam stops retain their source order
Dragging a tied conic color stop uses the inverse layer transform and local sweep angle, preserving every other stop, RGBA color and authored gradient parameter with exact history
Double-clicking the native conic ring appends a correctly interpolated RGBA stop without changing existing indices, and undo/redo preserves the complete angular paint
Native PNG pixels independently confirm the edited radial brush's equal relative radii on a nonsquare rectangle, with no exported handle adorners or changes from export
Native conic PNG samples prove a real canvas sweep-handle rotation changes the exported start ray and quarter/half-turn colors while preserving document state and excluding adorners

Native UTF-16 selection across a non-BMP character authors one complete UTF-8 paragraph with independent alignment, Auto direction, line height, letter spacing, before/after spacing and first-line indentation in the actual TextPresenter
A collapsed native caret styles only its paragraph; RTL alignment and spacing move the real layout, invalid metrics fail atomically and repeated Apply remains a no-op
Paragraph Inherit has exact one-step undo/redo and preserves the first paragraph; its native clipped-artboard PNG has exact dimensions, three text bands and the authored transparent spacing gap

Real native Unicode editing splits paragraph styles with correct UTF-8 remapping and shared line/caret offsets; cancel restores the original, commit is one exact undo/redo step and JSON round-trip preserves every paragraph field

A real native clipboard paste at the start of identical Unicode paragraphs inherits the first paragraph only; native Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Shift+Z restore exact character and paragraph ranges and actual line indentation, while the complete session remains one document history step

Deleting a complete repeated paragraph keeps the surviving suffix's distinct fonts, colors and paragraph metrics; native undo restores the deleted rich data, redo restores the exact deletion, and Escape cancels without a document history entry
Native guide-variable pickers bind numeric count and alpha color through typed controls, resolve the actual stack values and preserve exact single-step history
Invalid fractional count bindings are rejected atomically; native mode activation updates bound geometry/color together, and explicit Enter on an equal literal detaches only that field
Moving a guide remaps its variable keys with the complete stack entry, retains each resolved value and round-trips every binding through native JSON and exact undo/redo
Native child constraints resize relative to hidden stretch guide sections; switching the same guide to a fixed alignment restores ordinary frame-relative resizing without changing hierarchy
All nine toolbar controls fit at 980×650; native toolbar pointer input switches tools
Native Add page clicks retain a scrollable page list and usable layer viewport at 980×650
A committed IndexedDB autosave restores the exact document after a real browser reload
Native nudge/undo/redo in 10,000 layers each prepare one leaf, rebuild no immutable visuals, and reuse the scene and layer projection
Native zoom into 10,000 layers narrows root bounds testing and paint candidates to the local viewport without dropping visible layers
10,000 rendered layers retain bounded native row realization, real pointer/nudge/undo/redo, and exact durable reload
